title: auth.rs AuthProvider: cross-module panic consequence needs callsite pointer
description: In auth.rs, the AuthProvider trait doc says that implementations violating the header-value contract 'will cause a panic in the WebSocket connection path (connect_ws)'. This is a non-obvious cross-module consequence: the panic occurs in ws/mod.rs connect_ws at the header parse step, not at the AuthProvider call site. A contributor implementing a custom AuthProvider who tests it only with HTTP (not WebSocket) will not see the panic in testing. The trait doc should either link to connect_ws or note that the panic is deferred until the auth header is parsed into a typed HeaderName/HeaderValue (only done in the WS path, not the HTTP path which uses .as_str() directly).
